name: Superlist
description:
The Superlist connector brings your tasks, lists, and projects into Claude, so you can plan and act on your work without leaving the conversation.

Superlist is a collaborative task manager for people and teams. With this connector, Claude can see what is on your plate, capture new work as it comes up, and keep your lists current. Ask what is due today, turn meeting notes into a structured list, reassign work across your team, or tidy up a project that has drifted out of date.

Key features

Capture tasks: add a single task, or create a whole list of tasks at once from notes, a transcript, or a conversation. Tasks support due dates in your local timezone and repeat rules for recurring work.

Stay on top of your day: pull up your Today view and your Inbox to see what is due and what still needs sorting.

Search your workspace: find any task or list by keyword before acting on it, so updates land on the right item.

Organize lists: create, rename, update, and delete lists. Move tasks between lists, and add or remove labels to keep everything grouped the way you work.

Collaborate: assign and unassign tasks to teammates, and share or unshare lists with the people who need them.

Complete and clean up: mark tasks done, edit their titles and details, or delete items you no longer need.

Everything runs against your live Superlist account, so what Claude sees is what you see in the app, and any change made through Claude shows up instantly for you and your collaborators.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Superlist to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Superlist to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.superlist.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Superlist MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Superlist lists 22 MCP tools, including add_label, add_list, add_task, assign_task, complete_task, delete_list, delete_task, fetch, get_list, get_lists, get_task, and inbox.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Superlist?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Superlist in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Superlist requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Superlist is developed by Superlist. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
